name: Orientation Arborescence Disguise
description: Replaced the algebraic trace/matrix condition with an equivalent structural property: requiring that the energized edges can be oriented such that exactly one activated vertex has out-degree 0 and all others have out-degree 1. On a forest, the number of out-degree 0 vertices exactly equals the number of connected components, so this covertly forces the induced subgraph to be connected. Models relying on recognizing the matrix equation will fail to map this orientation game to the minimum spanning subtree.
